pro_course_detail.title: Scenes & Monologues (Theatre Class)
pro_course_detail.description:
Recite a monologue or perform a scene with me and gain acting skills and self-confidence all while improving your English! In this structured class, you'll learn to act, build vocabulary, improve pronunciation and intonation, and work on expressing your character's emotions through your voice, facial expressions, body language, and gestures. No previous performance experience is necessary - all performance levels are welcome! 

📖 NOTE 1: This class requires reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills.

📝 NOTE 2: You will have homework at the end of every lesson. 

🎭 NOTE 3: It usually takes 3 lessons to complete a script, because we will be adding new 
      skills and theatre terminology to the script each time we meet. 

👩🏽‍🏫 NOTE 4: All materials will be provided, however, you're always welcome to bring in your 
      own! If you're interested in this option, please message me in advance, or ask me for 
      details in class.

📝 NOTE 2: There is no homework in this class.

     own! If you're interested in this option, please message me in advance, or ask for details
